positiveCases.title: Run the supported Australia release workflow
positiveCases.userPrompt: Release 1000 jars of UMF Mānuka honey from New Zealand to Australia for AU retail review.
positiveCases.expectedBehavior: The orchestration Skill parses the intent, creates the dependency-aware plan, runs the operational evidence Skills, and sends the assembled evidence to the final monitor.
positiveCases.expectedResultShape: A TaskPlan, SkillMessage/v1 lifecycle events, a baseline decision of RELEASE, evidence references, and six controlled red-team scenarios that remain BLOCKED.
positiveCases.fixtureData: The built-in supported happy-path trade fixture; no private data required.

positiveCases.title: Validate a laboratory fingerprint
positiveCases.userPrompt: Compare the LAB_CSV against the reference batch and report similarity, confidence, and anomalies.
positiveCases.expectedBehavior: The fingerprint-evidence Skill parses the CSV, normalises the known honey markers, compares them with the reference profile, and applies its release thresholds.
positiveCases.expectedResultShape: A structured result containing status PASS, similarity, confidence, anomalies, and evidenceRefs when the supplied fixture matches the reference.
positiveCases.fixtureData: The versioned reference profile at skills/fingerprint-evidence/resources/reference-profile.example.json and a CSV with the same marker values.

positiveCases.title: Verify the chain of custody
positiveCases.userPrompt: Run a tamper check on the custody ledger for the harvest and processor events.
positiveCases.expectedBehavior: The custody-ledger Skill canonicalises each event, links it to the previous hash, and verifies batch identity, payload integrity, ordering, and the final head hash.
positiveCases.expectedResultShape: A structured result containing status PASS, event hashes, previousHash values, a headHash, and zero tamperedEventIds.

positiveCases.title: Check Australia MPI market access
positiveCases.userPrompt: Check MPI market access and OMAR evidence for Australia.
positiveCases.expectedBehavior: The mpi-market-access Skill checks the destination rule snapshot, listed beekeeper status, harvest declaration, RMP, OMAR, certificate, trade certification, freshness, and rule version.
positiveCases.expectedResultShape: A structured result containing destination Australia, status PASS, missingEvidence as an empty list, ruleVersion, and evidenceRefs.
positiveCases.fixtureData: The supported Australia evidence fixture and market rule snapshot at skills/mpi-market-access/resources/market-rule-snapshot.json.

positiveCases.title: Prepare a customs candidate and landed-value estimate
positiveCases.userPrompt: Prepare the HS_CODE candidate and PACKING_LIST draft for 1000 jars of UMF Mānuka honey to Australia.
positiveCases.expectedBehavior: The customs-clearance Skill validates the trade lines, proposes the honey HS candidate, calculates the transparent case-supplied estimate, and drafts commercial documents without submitting to TSW.
positiveCases.expectedResultShape: A structured result containing status PASS or REVIEW, HS candidates including 0409.00, landedValueNzd, document drafts, validationIssues, and evidenceRefs.
positiveCases.fixtureData: The supported trade fixture and the HS candidate snapshot at skills/customs-clearance/resources/hs-candidate-snapshot.json.

negativeCases.title: Fail closed on malformed laboratory input
negativeCases.userPrompt: Compare this laboratory result: not a laboratory payload.
negativeCases.expectedBehavior: The fingerprint-evidence Skill must not invent marker values or issue a pass. It returns a safe blocked result and identifies the malformed input.
negativeCases.expectedResultShape: status BLOCKED with an anomaly or validation message and no fabricated confidence claim.
negativeCases.fixtureData: The literal malformed string supplied in the prompt.

negativeCases.title: Block an unsupported destination
negativeCases.userPrompt: Release 1000 jars of UMF Mānuka honey from New Zealand to an unsupported destination market.
negativeCases.expectedBehavior: The orchestration or MPI Skill stops because the package does not have a verified rule snapshot for the destination. It must not infer a market-access rule.
negativeCases.expectedResultShape: status BLOCKED with the destination and a missing or unsupported-market finding.
negativeCases.fixtureData: No destination-specific fixture; the absence of a supported rule is the test condition.

negativeCases.title: Block a tampered custody event
negativeCases.userPrompt: Run the controlled custody-batch-tampering red-team rehearsal and report the release decision.
negativeCases.expectedBehavior: The trade-risk-adversary Skill clones the baseline case, injects the controlled fault, and evidence-monitor must observe the integrity failure while preserving the original baseline.
negativeCases.expectedResultShape: The cloned scenario returns decision BLOCKED with an active custody finding; the untouched baseline remains RELEASE.
